THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
BLUE & GOLD
030
38 / Quilted Crimson
Tousled auburn-brown hair falling past the shoulders,
pale gray-green eyes and soft nude lips against a pure black
backdrop. A navy ribbed roll-neck rises above diamond-quilted
navy panels with leather piping, framed by a textured rust-red
shearling-style outer layer.
39 / Gilded Jewel
Dark brown hair in a low, softly undone chignon with a
center part and loose face-framing strands, pale blue eyes with a
soft shimmer and peach-coral lips. A sheer tulle neckline over a
gold-embroidered metallic bodice is layered with a draped,
jeweled choker and large chandelier earrings with black stones
and pearls.
